Author: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi
Bench: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:108642-Db
Court No. - 29
Case :- Writ - C No. - 21527 of 2025
Petitioner :- Hidayat Khan and 3 others
Respondent :- Union of India and 3 others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Hari Om Tiwari,Shashi Kant Shukla Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,Akanksha Gaur,C.S.C.,Pranjal Mehrotra Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1. Heard Shri Shashi Kant Shukla, learned counsel for the petitioners, Shri Gopal Chandra Saxena,
learned Standing Counsel for State respondent nos.2 and 3 and Shri Pranjal Mehrotra, learned counsel for National Highways Authority of India (respondent no.4).

2. The instant writ petition under Article 226 of Constitution of India has been preferred for a direction to the District Magistrate, Jalaun at Orai (respondent no.3) to provide adequate compensation, solatium along with interest to the petitioners in lieu of acquisition of their land admeasuring 0.288 hectare of Plot No.333 situated at Village Langarpur, Tehsil Kalpi, District Jalaun acquired for widening of National Highway 25/27 vide notification dated 08.10.2009 issued Hidayat Khan And 3 Others vs Union Of India And 3 Others on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103620630/
1 under Section 3D of National Highways Act, 1956.
3.

entities.text: Hidayat Khan And 3 Others vs Union Of India And 3 Others on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways,
Government of India had issued a notification under Section 3A of the National Highways Act, 1956 for acquisition of land in District Jalaun including the petitioners' land for widening of National Highway No.25 (New No.27) from stretch 173.600 km. to 245.000 km.

entities.text:
Ministry of Road Transport and Highways,
Government of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Admittedly, the petitioners' holding had been utilised for widening of National Highway 25/27 but inspite of repeated requests, the petitioners have not been paid the compensation and the petitioners' grievance has not been redressed by the Competent Authority till date.

In support of his submission, he has placed reliance on the communication dated 17.06.2025 issued by the Project Director, National Highways Authority of India, Jhansi, wherein he has informed to the Competent Authority/Special Land Acquisition Officer, District Jalaun at Orai that the compensation is to be disbursed from the end of the Competent Authority.

entities.text: National Highways Authority of India, Jhansi
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He has confined the relief to a direction that the Competent Authority be directed to consider and decide the grievance of the petitioners and pay the adequate compensation to them.

4. Per contra, learned Standing Counsel and Shri Pranjal Mehrotra, learned counsel for the respondents fairly state that even though at this stage in absence of any such instruction, they are not in a position to accede the request of the petitioners but at the same time, it is submitted that in case any such claim is still pending consideration, definitely the Competent Authority would process the same in accordance with law.
5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that no useful purpose would be served in keeping the writ petition pending.

6. Accordingly, with the consent of the parties, the writ petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to submit a fresh representation before the Competent Authority, detailing all their grievances.

In the event such a representation is submitted within two weeks from today, the Competent Authority shall consider and decide the same on its own merits and in accordance with law, after affording an opportunity of hearing to all stakeholders.
The decision shall be taken expeditiously, preferably within a period of three months from the date of submission of the representation.

Order Date :- 9.7.2025 RKP  Hidayat Khan And 3 Others vs Union Of India And 3 Others on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103620630/
